fixesDuringStep: run.mjs used spawnSync while serving the artifact from its own process, so every page load hung; children now run asynchronously.
All six journeys wrote <version>_journey.json to one folder and overwrote each other; each journey now has its own results folder.

Production builds call https://api.scoutgrid.io/api when VITE_API_BASE is unset (src/api/base.ts). The e2e builds now set VITE_API_BASE=/api, and browser.mjs aborts every request to a host other than 127.0.0.1/localhost. Fixtures had answered all such calls before the fix; nothing was observed reaching the network.

The no-motion style removed animations, which dropped the rise-in fill transform on .ai-security-table-panel and made /policies overflow at 390px in a way no user sees. It now sets durations and delays to 0s instead.
findingsForLaterSteps: UI 2 overflow at 768px on /configurations/sla and /configurations/suppress, both themes (route-sweep reports it; not a gate failure). Not fixed in Step 2.

UI 2 adds 80 serious color-contrast and 12 extra serious scrollable-region-focusable axe violations compared with UI 1. Recorded in the baseline as the starting point, not accepted as passing; for the Step 5 accessibility review.
Hidden toggle inputs in .ai-policy-toggle depend on an animation's leftover transform to stay clipped; fragile if the animation is ever removed.
limitations: axe-baseline/{ui2,legacy}.json and journey-baseline/legacy.json were generated on the macOS host (Chromium from @playwright/test 1.63.0), not in the Playwright container.

Visual baselines PENDING: Docker is not installed here, so they cannot be generated in mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble. e2e:visual, e2e:affected and e2e:update stop at check-playwright-image.mjs on this host by design.
